method: Official pinned producer function transpiled and executed in a VM with fetch intercepted. Zero network requests. Payload content is synthetic; schema-specific acceptance is not asserted.
scope: SDK request serialization only. Service schema registry and receiver acceptance are external.
numeric_key_proof: Strict TypeScript allows publishMonorailEvent(7, {}, {}) because keyof the string-indexed Schemas includes number. The unchanged producer serializes schema_id 7.
serialization_boundary: Source-valid NaN numeric key serializes to null; schema-ID native types are intentionally unenforced.
